content.what_it_is: Python generator for a 500x500, 2 m grid with 10 m initial depth, linear outer-beach and inner-island slopes, and depth capped at -2 (L9-L41). It plots bathymetry, generates a vessel path whose radius ramps from 60 to 250 before remaining circular, calculates actual step speed, overlays the path, and writes a PNG, depth.txt, and four-column vessel_001.txt (L43-L108).

unresolved: Runtime API defect at L92: modern matplotlib.pyplot no longer exposes hold; the resulting AttributeError occurs before the trajectory plot and before all three writes at L96 and L107-L108. Plot hold is already implicit and the call is unnecessary.

Nominal/actual speed mismatch across L60, L77, L82, and L88: speed0 fixes only the angular rate at final Rship, while the changing radius adds radial speed and scales tangential speed. The saved actsp therefore differs from speed0 during the ramp.

Grid centering at L15-L16 yields even-sized coordinate ranges -500..498 rather than symmetric endpoints; saved vessel shifts at L103-L104 use the same origin, but intended cell-center/edge convention is undocumented.
Matplotlib pcolor at L49 does not specify shading while x/y lengths equal dep dimensions; display coverage/acceptance depends on Matplotlib version.
